title: VTA Collection — Claim — payload
description: A client with standing in a trust context asks its VTA to make it, until a stated end, the one collector of the messages queued at the mediator for an identifier whose keys the VTA holds there — a persona DID — or renews a claim it already holds. Before it grants, the VTA stops collecting for the identifier and closes every connection it holds for it; the client opens its own only once it holds the grant, and closes it before the claim ends unless it has renewed (VTI-NTF-081 – VTI-NTF-083). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

identifier.description: The identifier to collect for: one whose messaging keys the VTA holds in `contextId` and whose DID document advertises a transport through a mediator.

durationSeconds.description: How long the client asks the claim to last from the grant. The VTA grants no longer than the maximum it states, and may grant less; absent, it grants its own default. The granted end is `endsAt` in the response.

Response.title: VTA Collection — Claim — response payload
Response.description: The grant: the VTA has stopped collecting for `identifier` and closed every connection it held for it, and the caller is its collector until `endsAt`.

endsAt.description: When the claim ends unless renewed. The client stops collecting before this instant less its clock-skew tolerance (VTI-NTF-083).

renewed.description: True when the caller already held a claim for the identifier and this grant moved its end; absent or false for a new claim.
